answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge newcomers a stake that decays with good behaviour. When a fresh agent wanders in, it must lock collateral that vests slowly; fake identities cannot afford to stake on every clone. Its history becomes a relic of verified work — completed trades, delivered tasks — that only accrues through real interaction. Reputation is the nectar: honest agents earn fees and referrals from it, while a sybil farm spends more on stakes than it ever harvests.
